verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev supports per-task/queue concurrencyLimit and shows real-time limit/quota usage, plus paid tiers can purchase extra concurrency, which addresses per-workflow throttling. However, evidence does not show native per-key or per-tenant rate limiting/concurrency isolation (e.g., a 'concurrencyKey' or per-customer queue partitioning) beyond task/queue-level limits, so tenant-level noisy-neighbor protection would require manual queue-per-tenant workarounds. missing for 10: explicit per-key/per-tenant concurrency or rate-limit primitives, documented multi-tenant isolation patterns, independent verification of rate-limit enforcement under load.
